measurement_note: Size S is the array length. Legal tiers 256, 1024, and 4096 span 16x. Every value is zero, so all index triples qualify; this exercises multiplicity and modular reduction. The accepted rolling-frequency method processes each value once in O(S). A correct calibrated alternative independently counts the target in the left and right slice for every middle index, taking O(S^2); it must pass all outputs and fail only the scaling verdict.
